next_external_step: Keep Connect-Windows.ps1 running; close the game, run Install-Windows-Mod.ps1 in another Windows terminal with the same server, RemoteRoot and port, enable the Mod and stay at the main menu. Collect the displayed game release and verify bridge HTTP state before any controlled battle.
completion_rule: Do not mark complete until original-game behavior and declared supported scenario parity have been verified. Simulator-only tests do not prove local game parity.
limitations: References are received and hash-verified, but DLL assembly/file version 0.1.0.0 does not establish simulator target release 0.107.1; semantic release verification is still required.
Bridge compilation and Enchantment metadata checks passed; Windows installation, runtime behavior and actual original-game state/action/result are not yet verified.
Comparison coverage excludes catalog-derived card values and hidden RNG; a matching finite trace never proves global game parity.
Exact original/simulator initial state and RNG alignment still require implementation and live evidence.
Reference replay checks one declared seed and refuses initial-state mismatches; no automatic original-game staging or RNG import is implemented.
